coverage.evidence: NumTemplateHelpers.cs:15-31 registers the 12 groups under the num namespace, and their rows add up to the 36 keys the page lists (NumberBoundsHelpers.cs:17-20, NumberRoundingHelpers.cs:17-18, NumberPercentHelpers.cs:17-32, NumberSignHelpers.cs:17-20, NumberParityHelpers.cs:19-27, NumberDigitHelpers.cs:19-26, NumberFormatHelpers.cs:20-23, NumberCurrencyHelpers.cs:22-23, NumberWordHelpers.cs:21-25, NumberDurationHelpers.cs:20-22, NumberConvertHelpers.cs:16, NumberBarHelpers.cs:16). The argument counts match the Takes column: round 1-2 (NumberRoundingHelpers.cs:24-30), clamp and between exactly 3 (NumberBoundsHelpers.cs:19-20), percent 2-3 (NumberPercentHelpers.cs:39), currency exactly 2 (NumberCurrencyHelpers.cs:55-57), convert exactly 3 (NumberConvertHelpers.cs:23).

The page's examples match the code and the tests: NumberHelpersTableTests.cs:78,85,91-94,109,113,155-164,254 assert 1,234.50, forty-two, 1.5 KB, 2h 15m, 2 hours, 15 minutes, 1:23, 6.21, 5'11", $1,234.50, EUR 5.00 as the euro sign, 45s, 1m 30s and oneven. A bad argument returns null (NumberHelperGroup.cs:22, NumberHelperRow.cs:62-66), and TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46,100,117 then prints the token as written using RenderedToken.Content (RenderedToken.cs:29). The Roman row returns null for 0 (NumberWordHelpers.cs:46-47).

NumberHelperRow.cs:81-91 gives every row TemplateHelperContexts.StandardAndViewer, which holds every enum value (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:25-26): Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord, Webhook and Viewer (TemplateHelperContext.cs:18-62). Viewer text uses the Viewer helper set (TemplateResolver.cs:126) behind the feature labeled Viewer Templates (FeatureService.cs:92-93). The reward:input:template capability defaults to Subscriber (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:626-636).

ParsedArgument.cs:24 trims each argument. ParsedArgument.cs:35-41 parses with AllowLeadingSign and AllowDecimalPoint in the invariant culture, so 2,5, 1,000 and 1e3 fail. A whole number must have no fraction (NumberArguments.cs:38-45). A count of decimals is parsed with NumberStyles.None and must be at most MaxPlaces 10 (NumberArguments.cs:18,55-56; ParsedArgument.cs:27-28). A plain result uses invariant 0.########## with at most 10 decimals (NumberText.cs:22-26).

Duration input is whole seconds from 0 to 8,640,000,000, which is 100,000 days (NumberDurationHelpers.cs:26,38-44). The short form uses total hours with no days (NumberDurationHelpers.cs:47-54). The clock form keeps hours (NumberDurationHelpers.cs:60-63). The words form is Humanize with precision 2, and Humanizer 3.0.10 has maxUnit Week by default (NumberDurationHelpers.cs:56-57; Humanizer.xml:10013). Currency needs exactly 2 arguments and a known 3-letter code in any case, and the code only sets CurrencySymbol (NumberCurrencyHelpers.cs:27-35,55-57; NumberCurrencies.cs:22-27,31). Conversion needs units of the same dimension (NumberUnits.cs:28-53,56-71) and rounds to 2 places (NumberConvertHelpers.cs:18,31-33).

Only the WithCulture rows follow the channel language: format, currency, parity, words, ordinal, ordinal.words and the duration rows (NumberHelperRow.cs:37-41; NumberCulture.cs:22-38). format uses #,##0.########## or N<places> (NumberFormatHelpers.cs:44-46). currency uses C2 (NumberCurrencyHelpers.cs:32-34). currency.compact puts the symbol first plus the invariant compact form (NumberCurrencyHelpers.cs:38-45; NumberText.cs:36-49). Rounding is AwayFromZero (NumberText.cs:32-33). clamp returns null when min is above max (NumberBoundsHelpers.cs:24-25). The bar is clamped to 0-100 over 10 marks (MeterBars.cs:17,23-27,30). Feet and inches use truncated feet and rounded inches, and a negative fails (NumberUnits.cs:74-90).

reader_answers.evidence: The forms and the colon and pipe syntax match the rows (NumberRoundingHelpers.cs:22-33, NumberFormatHelpers.cs:35-47, NumberCurrencyHelpers.cs:27-35, NumberDurationHelpers.cs:20, NumberWordHelpers.cs:23, NumberText.cs:36-49). The currency code only sets the symbol (NumberCurrencyHelpers.cs:32-33).
Input rules match ParsedArgument.cs:35-41 and NumberArguments.cs:18,38-56. The viewer-text gate matches FeatureService.cs:92-99 and ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:626-636.

A null render prints as written (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46,117). 2,5 fails ParsedArgument.cs:35-41, 7.5 fails NumberArguments.cs:41, an unknown code fails NumberCurrencies.cs:22-27, and a word fails TryWhole (NumberDurationHelpers.cs:40).

Duration takes whole seconds (NumberDurationHelpers.cs:38-44) in the 3 forms at lines 47-63. Currency uses C2 with the code's symbol in the channel culture and no conversion (NumberCurrencyHelpers.cs:27-35). Nested arguments render before the helper (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:67), and args.<n> is a command argument key (ArgumentKeys.cs:22).
